title: TIRx: A Unified Tile Primitive ML Compiler Across Heterogeneous Backends
abstract: arXiv:2601.19092v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern ML kernels evolve rapidly with new optimizations and hardware features. ML compiler abstractions must accommodate richer memory hierarchies, more forms of thread cooperation, and increasingly heterogeneous backends while retaining the control required for peak performance. We present TIRx, an ML compiler for GPUs and AI accelerators that exposes these ingredients through explicit interfaces. TIRx introduces an explicit execution-scope abstraction that captures participating hardware teams at multiple granularities. It also uses tensor layouts to map logical tensors to heterogeneous hardware spaces through named axes and shard/replica/offset semantics. Finally, it introduces tile-primitive dispatch, which lowers high-level operations to efficient implementations according to scope, layout, and backend. This design preserves native-level control while automating recurring address calculation, operand preparation, and instr

translated_title: TIRx：跨异构后端的统一Tile原语机器学习编译器
translated_abstract: 现代机器学习内核随着新的优化技术和硬件特性快速演进。机器学习编译器抽象必须适应更丰富的内存层次结构、更多形式的线程协作以及日益异构的后端，同时保留达到峰值性能所需的控制能力。我们提出了TIRx，一个面向GPU和AI加速器的机器学习编译器，它通过显式接口暴露这些关键要素。TIRx引入了显式的执行作用域抽象，能够在多个粒度上捕获参与的硬件团队。它还使用张量布局，通过命名轴以及分片/副本/偏移语义，将逻辑张量映射到异构硬件空间。最后，它引入了tile原语分发机制，能够根据作用域、布局和后端将高层操作降低为高效的底层实现。这种设计在保留原生级别控制能力的同时，自动化了重复性的地址计算、操作数准备和指令生成工作。
tldr: TIRx通过显式执行作用域抽象、命名轴张量布局和tile原语分发机制，构建了一个能在GPU和AI加速器等异构后端之间统一工作、同时保留底层性能控制能力的机器学习编译器。
en_tdlr: TIRx is a unified ML compiler that introduces explicit execution scopes, named-axis tensor layouts, and tile-primitive dispatch to generate efficient code across heterogeneous GPU and AI accelerator backends while preserving native-level performance control.
